correctness.rationale: Geometric fixed points under <g> are not the set of originally fixed vertices: in barycentric realization the fixed coordinates are constant on every g-orbit of Hasse-cover vertices. Collapsing each admissible cover-edge orbit to a barycentric orbit vertex defines a PL homeomorphism between geometric fixed locus and exactly enumerated orbit complex F_g, including the empty cases. The underlying 15 nonempty tetrahedral faces have exactly 28 Hasse cover relations; every possible orbit subset is checked for matching condition and reversed-Hasse acyclicity. An independent fresh enumeration confirms face vectors (10,36,56,36,8) for transposition, (8,8) for double transposition, (3,3,1) for three-cycle, and empty for four-cycle. A new greedy free-face sequence, independent of the 60-pair provided certificate, collapses the first complex by 60 valid elementary pairs onto the full 6-vertex octahedron boundary S2. Double transposition consists of exactly two independent 4-cycles S1⊔S1; three-cycle is a filled triangle and thus contractible. The provided complete certificate and checker establish each case and all 24 group elements. Identity full homotopy ∨99 S4 is prior work, not reproved or claimed new.
